sentences.en: Mia found a wallet on the bus.
sentences.zh: 米雅在公車上撿到一個錢包。

sentences.en: Inside were some money and an ID card.
sentences.zh: 裡面有一些錢和一張身分證。

sentences.en: She was reluctant to keep it, so she decided to find the owner.
sentences.zh: 她不願意把它留下來，所以決定找到失主。

sentences.en: The card showed an address, but it was not accurate.
sentences.zh: 證件上有一個地址，但並不準確。

sentences.en: Mia did not abandon the plan and went to the police station.
sentences.zh: 米雅沒有放棄這個計畫，而是去了警察局。

sentences.en: An officer helped her call the owner.
sentences.zh: 一位警察幫她聯絡失主。

sentences.en: An hour later, a young man ran in, out of breath.
sentences.zh: 一小時後，一位年輕男子氣喘吁吁地跑進來。

sentences.en: He was grateful and thanked her again and again.
sentences.zh: 他非常感激，一再向她道謝。

sentences.en: Mia smiled and said that honesty brings its own benefit.
sentences.zh: 米雅微笑著說，誠實本身就會帶來好處。

sentences.en: Tom works for a small company in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 湯姆在台北一家小公司工作。

sentences.en: This morning, the manager announced a new project.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，經理宣布了一項新專案。

sentences.en: The goal was to eliminate waste and improve efficiency.
sentences.zh: 目標是消除浪費並提升效率。

sentences.en: Tom felt anxious because the schedule was tight.
sentences.zh: 湯姆感到焦慮，因為時程很緊。

sentences.en: The price of materials continued to fluctuate, so the budget was uncertain.
sentences.zh: 材料價格持續波動，所以預算並不確定。

sentences.en: His team shared ideas and made a clear plan.
sentences.zh: 他的團隊分享想法，擬定了一個清楚的計畫。

sentences.en: By evening, they had finished the first stage of the project.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚，他們已經完成了專案的第一階段。

sentences.en: Tom realized that teamwork is the key to success.
sentences.zh: 湯姆體會到團隊合作是成功的關鍵。

title: A Summer Trip to the Sea

sentences.en: Last summer, Anna and her little brother traveled to a small island.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，安娜和她的弟弟去一座小島旅行。

sentences.en: They took an overnight train and then a ferry.
sentences.zh: 他們先搭夜車，再搭渡輪。

sentences.en: The sea was calm, and the sky was clear.
sentences.zh: 海面很平靜，天空很晴朗。

sentences.en: Near the rocks, they saw colorful fish in the water.
sentences.zh: 在岩石附近，他們看見水裡有五顏六色的魚。

sentences.en: Her little brother was nervous about swimming, but Anna encouraged him.
sentences.zh: 她的弟弟對游泳感到緊張，但安娜鼓勵他。

sentences.en: In the evening, they watched a splendid sunset together.
sentences.zh: 傍晚，他們一起欣賞了壯麗的夕陽。

sentences.en: Anna said that she would never forget that peaceful day.
sentences.zh: 安娜說她永遠不會忘記那個平靜的日子。

title: A Busy Morning at the Airport

sentences.en: David checked his itinerary early in the morning before leaving for the airport.
sentences.zh: 大衛一早出門前往機場前，先確認了他的行程表。

sentences.en: When he arrived at the terminal, he looked at the departure board.
sentences.zh: 當他抵達航廈時，他看了一下出發告示牌。

sentences.en: There was a thirty-minute delay due to heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 因為大雨的關係，班機延誤了三十分鐘。

sentences.en: David used the extra time to confirm his hotel accommodation online.
sentences.zh: 大衛利用這段多出來的時間，在網路上確認了他的飯店住宿。

sentences.en: Soon, the staff announced that boarding for his flight would begin.
sentences.zh: 很快地，工作人員廣播宣布他的航班即將開始登機。

sentences.en: He picked up his bag and walked toward the gate with excitement.
sentences.zh: 他拿起包包，興奮地朝登機門走去。

sentences.en: Our team had to submit a new product proposal before Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊必須在週五下午前提交一份新的產品企劃案。

sentences.en: On Monday, our supervisor held a meeting to review the agenda.
sentences.zh: 週一時，我們的主管召開了一場會議來檢視議程。

sentences.en: Everyone received a clear assignment to improve overall efficiency.
sentences.zh: 每個人都分配到了明確的任務，以提升整體效率。

sentences.en: Two departments decided to collaborate closely on the budget plan.
sentences.zh: 兩個部門決定在預算計畫上密切合作。

sentences.en: Although the schedule was tight, nobody felt reluctant to help.
sentences.zh: 雖然時程很緊湊，但沒有人對幫忙感到不情願。

sentences.en: We finished the final document on time and received positive feedback.
sentences.zh: 我們準時完成了最終文件，並獲得了正面的回饋。

sentences.en: Kevin bought a new tablet with a large storage capacity.
sentences.zh: 凱文買了一台擁有大容量儲存空間的新平板電腦。

sentences.en: First, he connected the device to his home Wi-Fi network.
sentences.zh: 首先，他將這台裝置連上家裡的 Wi-Fi 網路。

sentences.en: The connection was fast, so the system update took only five minutes.
sentences.zh: 連線速度很快，所以系統更新只花了五分鐘。

sentences.en: Next, he opened the settings menu to turn on automatic backups.
sentences.zh: 接著，他打開設定選單，開啟了自動備份功能。

sentences.en: He also learned a useful shortcut to switch between apps quickly.
sentences.zh: 他也學了一個實用的捷徑，可以快速在不同應用程式之間切換。

sentences.en: Kevin really liked the clean interface and smooth performance.
sentences.zh: 凱文非常喜歡它簡潔的介面和流暢的效能。

sentences.en: Emily went to an electronics store to purchase a lightweight laptop.
sentences.zh: 艾蜜莉去了一家電子產品專賣店，想購買一台輕薄筆電。

sentences.en: The clerk recommended a model that was currently on a twenty percent discount.
sentences.zh: 店員推薦了一款目前正在打八折的型號。

sentences.en: Emily also used a gift voucher she received from her company.
sentences.zh: 艾蜜莉也使用了她從公司收到的禮券。

sentences.en: The clerk explained that the laptop came with a two-year warranty.
sentences.zh: 店員說明這台筆電隨附兩年的保固。

sentences.en: He reminded her to keep the receipt in case she needed a refund or repair.
sentences.zh: 他提醒她要保留收據，以防需要退款或維修。

sentences.en: Emily was very happy to get a genuine bargain.
sentences.zh: 艾蜜莉很高興能買到真正划算的商品。

sentences.en: Sarah called her friend Tom to apologize for changing their dinner plan.
sentences.zh: 莎拉打電話給朋友湯姆，為更改他們的晚餐計畫道歉。

sentences.en: She had an urgent task at work and needed to postpone their meeting.
sentences.zh: 她工作上有一個緊急任務，需要把他們的聚會延期。

sentences.en: Tom said it was no problem and asked when she would be available.
sentences.zh: 湯姆說沒關係，並問她什麼時候有空。

sentences.en: They checked their schedules and agreed on Thursday evening instead.
sentences.zh: 他們確認了彼此的行程，改約在週四晚上。

sentences.en: Sarah promised to contact the restaurant to reserve a table for two.
sentences.zh: 莎拉答應會聯繫餐廳預約兩人座的位子。

sentences.en: Tom appreciated her quick update and wished her good luck with work.
sentences.zh: 湯姆很感謝她即時通知，並祝她工作順利。

sentences.en: Mark used to feel a lot of anxiety about his busy workweek.
sentences.zh: 馬克過去常常對忙碌的工作週感到非常焦慮。

sentences.en: To reduce stress, he decided to build a new weekend habit.
sentences.zh: 為了減輕壓力，他決定建立一個新的週末習慣。

sentences.en: Every Saturday morning, he goes jogging in the park during his leisure time.
sentences.zh: 每週六早上，他都會在空閒時間去公園慢跑。

sentences.en: At first, waking up early was hard, so he was reluctant to leave his bed.
sentences.zh: 起初早起很困難，所以他很不情願離開被窩。

sentences.en: After a month, his body became accustomed to the fresh air and exercise.
sentences.zh: 一個月後，他的身體漸漸習慣了新鮮空氣和運動。

sentences.en: Now, his stress has diminished, and he feels full of energy every Monday.
sentences.zh: 現在他的壓力減輕了，每個星期一都感到精力充沛。

sentences.en: Three years ago, Jenny opened a small coffee shop with a limited budget.
sentences.zh: 三年前，珍妮用有限的預算開了一家小咖啡店。

sentences.en: Because coffee bean prices fluctuate often, she had to manage costs carefully.
sentences.zh: 因為咖啡豆價格經常波動，她必須謹慎控制成本。

sentences.en: She kept accurate financial records every month to eliminate unnecessary waste.
sentences.zh: 她每個月都保留精確的財務紀錄，以消除不必要的浪費。

sentences.en: Soon, her shop gained loyal customers, and annual revenue grew steadily.
sentences.zh: 很快地，她的店累積了忠實顧客，年營業額也穩定成長。

sentences.en: Last month, a corporate partner offered a new investment for market expansion.
sentences.zh: 上個月，一家企業合作夥伴提出了新的投資，協助她擴展市場。

sentences.en: Jenny did not hesitate to accept the offer and planned her second store.
sentences.zh: 珍妮毫不猶豫地接受了這個提議，並開始規劃她的第二家分店。

sentences.en: In recent years, air pollution has become a serious urban problem.
sentences.zh: 近年來，空氣污染已成為嚴重的都市問題。

sentences.en: Local leaders concluded that planting more trees and adding bike lanes would help.
sentences.zh: 當地領導人下結論認為，種植更多樹木和增設自行車道會有所幫助。

sentences.en: Although rapid change seemed inevitable, some residents worried about road traffic.
sentences.zh: 雖然快速改變似乎無可避免，但部分居民仍擔心道路交通問題。

sentences.en: The city government held public meetings to clarify the long-term benefits.
sentences.zh: 市政府舉辦了公開說明會，以澄清這項計畫的長期益處。

sentences.en: Today, cleaner air and greener parks have improved public welfare for everyone.
sentences.zh: 如今，更乾淨的空氣和更綠意盎然的公園提升了所有人的公共福祉。

sentences.en: Many citizens now ride bicycles to work instead of driving cars.
sentences.zh: 許多市民現在改騎自行車上班，而不是開車。

sentences.en: Our neighborhood welcomes families from many different countries and backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 我們的社區歡迎來自許多不同國家和背景的家庭。

sentences.en: This cultural diversity makes local events lively and educational.
sentences.zh: 這種文化多樣性讓在地活動既熱鬧又富有教育意義。

sentences.en: Last Sunday, the community center hosted a food and music festival.
sentences.zh: 上週日，社區活動中心舉辦了一場美食與音樂節。

sentences.en: According to a demographic survey, over five hundred residents attended the event.
sentences.zh: 根據一項人口統計調查，有超過五百位居民參加了這場活動。

sentences.en: Neighbors shared traditional dishes and talked about their daily lives.
sentences.zh: 鄰居們分享傳統料理，並聊著彼此的日常生活。

sentences.en: Everyone agreed that the festival brought a significant sense of unity.
sentences.zh: 大家都認同這場節慶帶來了顯著的團結感。

sentences.en: While walking home from the train station, Lisa saw a brown wallet on the bench.
sentences.zh: 麗莎從火車站走回家時，看見長椅上有一個棕色皮夾。

sentences.en: She checked inside and realized it was made of genuine leather and held cash and ID cards.
sentences.zh: 她檢查了裡面，發現它是真皮製成的，裡面裝有現金和證件。

sentences.en: Lisa did not abandon it; instead, she took it to the nearest police station.
sentences.zh: 麗莎沒有對它置之不理，而是把它帶到了最近的警察局。

sentences.en: The officer praised her honesty and contacted the owner right away.
sentences.zh: 員警稱讚了她的誠實，並立刻聯繫了失主。

sentences.en: When the owner arrived, Lisa reassured him that nothing was missing.
sentences.zh: 當失主趕到時，麗莎向他保證裡面沒有任何東西遺失。

sentences.en: The grateful man thanked Lisa warmly for her genuine kindness.
sentences.zh: 這位感激的男子熱情地感謝麗莎真誠的善舉。

sentences.en: Last month, Jason saw that a top tech company was trying to recruit new engineers.
sentences.zh: 上個月，傑森看到一家頂尖科技公司正在招募新工程師。

sentences.en: He updated his resume and applied for a role in the hardware department.
sentences.zh: 他更新了履歷表，並應徵了硬體部門的職位。

sentences.en: Because he had strong testing experience, he was well qualified for the job.
sentences.zh: 因為他擁有紮實的測試經驗，他非常勝任這份工作。

sentences.en: Before the interview, he practiced answering questions without any hesitation.
sentences.zh: 在面試之前，他練習毫不猶豫地回答各種問題。

sentences.en: Two days later, the manager called and offered him the position.
sentences.zh: 兩天後，經理打電話來正式錄取了他。

sentences.en: Claire moved into a bright apartment in a peaceful neighborhood last weekend.
sentences.zh: 克萊兒上週末搬進了一個寧靜社區裡的明亮公寓。

sentences.en: She spent two days unpacking boxes and buying basic furniture for her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 她花了兩天拆箱，並為臥室添購了基本家具。

sentences.en: She also organized her desk so she could study comfortably at night.
sentences.zh: 她還整理了書桌，這樣晚上就能舒適地讀書。

sentences.en: Best of all, the apartment is close to public transportation and a large supermarket.
sentences.zh: 最棒的是，這間公寓靠近大眾運輸站和一間大型超市。

sentences.en: Claire definitely felt that moving here was a great decision.
sentences.zh: 克萊兒肯定地覺得搬來這裡是一個很棒的決定。

title: Fixing a Slow Web App
title_zh: 修復緩慢的網頁應用程式

sentences.en: Several users reported that our company website was loading slowly on their screens.
sentences.zh: 有幾位使用者回報，我們公司的網站在他們的螢幕上載入得很慢。

sentences.en: Our engineers checked the server and found an issue with the database query.
sentences.zh: 我們的工程師檢查了伺服器，發現資料庫查詢出現了問題。

sentences.en: They optimized the code and advised users to refresh their web browser.
sentences.zh: 他們最佳化了程式碼，並建議使用者重新整理網頁瀏覽器。

sentences.en: After the update, the website loaded twice as fast as before.
sentences.zh: 更新之後，網站載入速度比以前快了一倍。

sentences.en: Users preferred the smoother experience and sent positive messages to our team.
sentences.zh: 使用者更喜歡這種流暢的體驗，並向我們團隊發送了正面回饋。

sentences.en: Ben and his girlfriend wanted to take a short trip to the coast this weekend.
sentences.zh: 班和他的女友想在這個週末去海邊來趟短途旅行。

sentences.en: They made a hotel reservation online at an affordable price.
sentences.zh: 他們在網路上以實惠的價格預訂了飯店。

sentences.en: Ben also read a local guidebook to find famous seafood restaurants near the harbor.
sentences.zh: 班還看了一本當地旅遊指南，尋找港口附近有名的海鮮餐廳。

sentences.en: On Saturday morning, the train was full of excited passengers heading out of the city.
sentences.zh: 週六早上，火車上坐滿了興奮地準備出城遊玩的乘客。

sentences.en: They bought local snacks from a well-known brand before returning home on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 他們在週日回家前，買了一家知名品牌的當地點心。
